policy: Generate modular pieces, not full characters. One shared base body + shared animations; each slot is a separate asset aligned to the same proportions/canvas. AI output is concept/layer/material only; 3D meshes still need modeling/rigging/cleanup.

style.camera: 2.5D isometric, fixed 3/4 top-down orthographic camera, pitch 50, yaw 45
style.render: low-poly silhouette with crisp pixel-art texture, 1px dark outline, no anti-aliasing
style.palette: 32-color palette: navy #0B1020, ground #1B263B, cyan #63D6FF, gold #F2C14E, danger red #FF6B6B, skin #F2C6A0, steel #DCE6F2
style.negative: full character, multiple characters, animation frames, sprite sheet, photorealistic, 3D render, smooth gradient, anti-aliasing, blur, extra limbs, text, logo, watermark, existing franchise character, trademark

base_body.prompt: neutral base body mannequin for a 2.5D action game, slim heroic 1.8m proportions, featureless face, neutral A-pose, no clothes except plain undergarment, front 3/4 / side / back turnaround, orthographic, transparent background, same palette, clean silhouette
base_body.use: reference for shared body/skeleton and all equipment; not a playable final skin

hair.prompt: hair piece only, short cyan-black hair, separate asset, front/side/back views, transparent background, aligned to same head proportions as base body, no face, no body, clean 1px outline
hair.use: concept / 2D hair layer; 3D needs mesh + bone/skinning

top.prompt: top garment only, worn navy short coat with leather straps, no body inside, front/side/back views, transparent background, same palette, clean silhouette, matching base body proportions
top.use: concept / 2D top layer; 3D needs skinned mesh + hidden body regions

bottom.prompt: bottom garment only, dark trousers with leather belt, no body inside, front/side/back views, transparent background, same palette, clean silhouette

shoes.prompt: pair of boots only, dark leather with steel toe, front/side/back views, transparent background, same palette, clean silhouette

cape.prompt: short cape only, navy cloth with cyan trim, back and side views, transparent background, clean silhouette, separate from body

weapon_main.prompt: single sword only, slim dueling blade, steel with cyan accent, three-quarter/side views, transparent background, clean 1px outline, no hand
weapon_main.use: concept / 3D prop; attach to hand bone

weapon_offhand.prompt: small offhand guard or dagger only, separate asset, transparent background, clean silhouette, no hand

ugc_texture_template.prompt: flat UV texture template for a low-poly coat, color-coded UV islands, no lighting, no text, no character, neutral base color
ugc_texture_template.warning: AI cannot know our UV layout; use this only as a colour/pattern mood reference. Real template must be exported from the actual mesh UVs.

2d_layer_rules.alignment: same canvas, feet pivot (48,8), same body proportions and animation frame count as base
2d_layer_rules.layers: base_body, hair, top, bottom, shoes, cape, weapon; no full character combined

3d_rules.skeleton: one shared humanoid skeleton; all equipment skinned to it or attached to sockets
3d_rules.slots: hair, face, head_accessory, top, bottom, shoes, gloves, cape, weapon_main, weapon_offhand
3d_rules.uv: fixed UV template per item; UGC only replaces texture, never geometry
3d_rules.ai_note: AI 3D meshes must be retopologized/rigged/cleaned; do not ship raw AI mesh
